verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own Notifications API for subscribing to CRM data-change events. It supports field-level event filters and channels with configurable expiry, replacing polling. Bulk Write also documents a callback URL that receives job-completion notifications. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that event notifications are delivered as HTTP POSTs to a registered notify URL (only bulk-write mentions a callback URL), payload/retry/signature details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get notified whenever a data change occurs inside your CRM. Eliminate sending polling requests to check for data changes.
you can also choose to get notifications when an event occurs only on certain fields of the module. For example, raising an alert when a Deal's Stage is updated.
Set expiry time for every channel and have better control over notifications.
When the records are processed, the system notifies you of job completion in the callback URL
